sections.heading: What patch 1.17 actually says about opponents
sections.format: Two-row actual HTML table: Official note / What it does not establish
points: The patch announced a revised matchmaking experiment without publishing its formula.
The patch reported fixing bots leaving the edge of the map; this does not establish the share of bots or their removal.
sections.exceptionReason: Dated patch reference, not a demonstrated match or bot detector.

sections.heading: Keep a short record before calling something a counter
sections.format: Editorial checklist, clearly advice rather than a game rule
points: Record the displayed version and only the units/layout/result you can actually see.
Separate the action taken from the observed result; mark opponent identity and hidden values unknown.
One outcome cannot establish a universal counter or matchmaking rule.
sections.exceptionReason: A short observation note, with no promised interface route or successful matchup.
